THE LOCKER SHALL CONFORM TO THE TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION MENTIONED IN THE BID DOCUMENT. 3. THE LOCKER SHALL BE MANUFACTURED FROM THE SPECIFIED MATERIAL (MARINE GRADE ALUMINIUM / CRCA STEEL WITH POWDER COATING OR EQUIVALENT AS SPECIFIED). 4. ALL COMPONENTS, FITTINGS, HINGES, HANDLES, LOCKING ARRANGEMENTS AND ACCESSORIES SHALL B E SUPPLIED COMPLETE AND READY FOR USE. 5. THE LOCKER SHALL BE PROVIDED WITH AN EFFECTIVE LOCKING ARRANGEMENT FOR EACH COMPARTMENT AS SPECIFIED. 6. THE SURFACE FINISH SHALL BE CORROSION-RESISTANT AND SUITABLE FOR TROPICAL, HUMID AND COA STAL ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS. 7. THE BIDDER SHALL ENSURE PROPER PACKING TO PREVENT DAMAGE DURING TRANSPORTATION, HAND LING AND STORAGE. 8. DELIVERY SHALL BE COMPLETE WITHIN THE PERIOD SPECIFIED IN THE PURCHASE ORDER. 9. INSTALLATION, POSITIONING AND FIXING AT THE CONSIGNEE PREMISES SHALL BE INCLUDED IN THE SC OPE OF SUPPLY WITHOUT ADDITIONAL COST. .
